classification.difficultyReason: Apply the stated odd or even symmetry to supplied qualitative branches, preserving turning points, intercepts and tail directions; both symmetry operations are directly taught.

content.prompt:
In each diagram below, complete the graph so that:
i $f(x)$ is odd,
ii $f(x)$ is even.

spec.description: Unscaled axes and supplied third-quadrant branch, approaching the origin with a horizontal tangent. Repeated for independent odd and even completions.
spec.mathematics: Qualitative source curve; no function equation or numerical scale is asserted.

answer.short: Add the half-turn image of the supplied branch about the origin.
answer.worked: For an odd function, $f(-x)=-f(x)$. Map each supplied point $(x,y)$ to $(-x,-y)$, adding the matching first-quadrant branch.

spec.description: Origin-symmetric completed curve with opposite end directions.
spec.mathematics: The added branch is the exact half-turn image of the supplied Bézier branch.

spec.description: Independent copy of diagram a for the even completion.
spec.mathematics: Same unscaled supplied branch as part i.

answer.short: Reflect the supplied branch in the $y$-axis.
answer.worked: For an even function, $f(-x)=f(x)$. Map each supplied point $(x,y)$ to $(-x,y)$, adding the matching fourth-quadrant branch.

spec.description: Even completion with maximum at the origin and both tails downward.
spec.mathematics: Exact reflection of the supplied branch in the vertical axis.

spec.description: Unscaled right-hand branch from the origin, with one maximum, a positive x-intercept and descending tail.
spec.mathematics: Qualitative source curve; no numerical coordinates or equation are supplied.

answer.short: Add the half-turn image of the supplied branch about the origin.
answer.worked: Use $f(-x)=-f(x)$: map $(x,y)$ to $(-x,-y)$. The left branch has a minimum below the $x$-axis and continues upward to the left.

spec.description: Odd completion: right maximum, left minimum and opposite tail directions.
spec.mathematics: The left branch is the half-turn image of the right branch.

spec.description: Independent copy of diagram b for the even completion.
spec.mathematics: Same unscaled supplied branch as part i.

answer.short: Reflect the supplied branch in the $y$-axis.
answer.worked: Use $f(-x)=f(x)$: map $(x,y)$ to $(-x,y)$. The matching humps meet at the origin and both outer tails point downward.

spec.description: Even completion with two matching humps and downward outer tails.
spec.mathematics: The left branch is the reflection of the right branch in the y-axis.
